scope: Reviewer-only timing hazards. This file must not be supplied to an earlier historical author. Current retrieval of original dated release pages verifies the release boundary, not original news-body vintages or every claim in a report.
method: Independent web search/open of official dated releases and calendars. Clock conversions use the event date's local timezone; a later same-day edition cannot be substituted for the midnight edition.
